note: Provisioned IOPS storage is designed for I/O-intensive database workloads with low, consistent latency (RDS storage types), and a larger class adds the saturated compute. The Multi-AZ standby serves no read traffic and read replicas are read-only (Concepts.MultiAZ, USER_ReadRepl), so A, D and E fail.

RDS Proxy pools and reuses database connections (rds-proxy), so the functions only switch to the proxy endpoint and the database sees fewer connections. A and D do not reduce connections; B adds a read-only replica.

DynamoDB is serverless with consistent single-digit-millisecond performance at scale (aws.amazon.com/dynamodb), keyed by player ID. The RDS options need database servers to manage; Redshift is a warehouse.
